note: The model never calls a model API from the phone. All Groq calls go through the Express API. The AI tools only change the cart, and a person must tap Confirm Order to place it, so the AI cannot place an order alone. Tool results are fed back to the model in a loop of up to 10 calls. The order endpoint is fake. No database and no auth exist. No committed .env, and .env.example holds a gsk_ placeholder, not a real key. App.tsx and index.ts are the unused Expo template, because package.json main is expo-router/entry.

labels.what: POST /orders makes a random order id and a random 15 to 24 minute wait, then returns the cart. Nothing is stored, no kitchen is told, no payment is taken, and no table is recorded. The app still shows Order Confirmed and says the table will be served shortly
Order schema takes unitPrice and name from the client and never re-prices against the menu. update_item in tools.ts line 142 also keeps the client price from the incoming cart
10 percent service charge and the order total exist only in the phone app. The server never computes a total
Whole menu with prices, tags and specials is a hardcoded array. It is served from /menu and copied into the system prompt as the real menu, so price or stock changes need a code deploy
get_menu returns the hardcoded MENU array. base.ts also filters it out, so the model is never offered this tool
add_item and update_item accept any positive integer quantity with no maximum, so one model call can put hundreds of a dish in the cart
remove_item and clear_cart change the cart on the model's call alone, and the phone applies the diff with no confirm step. Placing the order still needs a tap
Prompt forbids re-adding an item already in the cart unless the guest asks for another. add_item does not look at the cart, and the merge step adds to the quantity
Prompt says never remove items the guest did not name. clear_cart and remove_item have no check, so a model slip empties the cart
Prompt says only act on items named in the current message. No code compares tool calls with the latest message
Prompt forbids adding a substitute for an unlisted dish. Code only checks that the id exists on the menu
POST /chat calls paid Groq with no rate limit, no auth and no quota. One request can run up to 10 completions in the tool loop
Server accepts any number of messages of any length. The 500 character cap exists only in the phone TextInput
Client-supplied cart item names go straight into the system prompt and the last user message with no check against the menu, which allows prompt injection
Client can send messages with role assistant, so it can forge the waiter's past replies in the history sent to the model
cors() with no options allows every origin to call the paid chat endpoint and the order endpoint
No login, table id or session on /chat or /orders. Anyone who finds the API can post orders, and an order has no table to serve
API base URL falls back to http://localhost:3000, which fails on a real phone
Ollama base URL defaults to http://localhost:11434/v1
Startup log prints a localhost URL. Port defaults to 3000 at line 9
Tool loop limit of 10 model calls per request is hardcoded
